items.verbatim: WEDC Tax Credit under the Business Development Tax Credit program, awarded 2021-08-05 to a recipient in Town of Lisbon, Waukesha County. Industry: Manufacturing (NAICS 325910). Award amount: $200,000. Planned project cost: $7,428,000. Planned capital investment: $5,378,000. Planned job creation: 25.
